u_wind.coordinate_transform: None for CCMP; Geospatial swath binning for ASCAT L2
blocking_reasons: ASCAT L2 Coastal swath granules cover only ~1 day (2020-01-01, 16 granules). Remaining 29 daily periods are missing. Data is ungridded swath (L2) requiring spatial binning. CCMP V3.1 L4 gap-free product is not downloaded.
u_wind.remediation_command: Acquire CCMP V3.1 gridded daily 0.25° wind vectors from NASA PO.DAAC or ECMWF ERA5 10m wind reanalysis fallback (u10, v10) via CDS API.
u_wind.fallback_details: GLORYS12V1 is an ocean circulation reanalysis and DOES NOT contain atmospheric 10m wind variables. Reanalysis fallback requires external ECMWF ERA5 winds.
